name: Rain-Praying Altar of Chechi
owner: Tiger-Strength Immortal · Deer-Strength Immortal · Antelope-Strength Immortal
structure: Three-tier altar · command tokens · talisman water · divine-general edicts
principle: Commands the gods to bring rain through the Five-Thunder Rite, relying on the Heavenly Court's orthodox talisman-edict system
weakness: Wukong impersonated false gods · disrupted the Cloud and Rain Bureaus · edicts never left the altar
result: Tiger-Strength's rain prayer failed · the three immortals died
feature: A typical orthodox Daoist rain altar, connecting to the Heavenly Court's Cloud and Rain Bureaus through talisman edicts

name: Cobweb Array of Pansi Cave
structure: Sky-filling spider silk · sticking and binding the pilgrims
principle: The seven sisters' innate silk web — whatever mortal thing touches it sticks fast
weakness: Wukong's Golden-Banded Staff tangled the silk · easily broken
result: Array broken · the seven sisters fled to Yellow-Flower Monastery
feature: Cultivated jointly by the seven sisters; the silk-web array forms a dome covering the surroundings of Pansi Cave

name: Myriad-Demon Array of Lion-Camel Ridge
owner: Green Lion · White Elephant · Great Peng
structure: Eight-hundred-li Lion-Camel Ridge · Lion-Camel Cave · Lion-Camel Kingdom
principle: Intercepts the pilgrims with massed demon formations · big and small demons each assigned roles
weakness: None (backed by the overwhelming strength of the three demon kings)
result: Wukong was captured in the Yin-Yang Two-Qi Vase · later broke the vase · ultimately Tathagata descended in person
feature: The largest demon array in scale; its demon count rivals the heavenly hosts

name: Jindou Cave · Vajra Ring Array
type: Treasure array · a single device sucks in weapons
structure: One ring takes ten thousand weapons
principle: The Vajra Ring's causal law · snares all the gods' weapons
weakness: Cannot capture Wukong himself · required Taishang Laojun to descend in person
result: All the gods' weapons were snared · Wukong left empty-handed · finally Laojun subdued it
feature: A causal-law weapon · breaking the principle that 'weapons can win'

name: Minor Thunderclap Monastery · Golden Cymbals · Human Seed Pouch
type: Composite array · the Golden Cymbals trap people · the Human Seed Pouch gathers the crowd
structure: A trap set in a false Buddha hall · the Golden Cymbals and Human Seed Pouch work in tandem
principle: The Golden Cymbals trapped Wukong · the Human Seed Pouch took the Twenty-Eight Mansions · all the gods entered the pouch
weakness: The Golden Dragon of Kang's horn broke the cymbals · Maitreya descended to reclaim the pouch
result: All the heavenly generals were captured · Maitreya subdued them
feature: A causal-law weapon · part of Maitreya Buddha's treasury; a single page-boy could trap the gods

name: Bottomless Cave · Spirit-Tablet House Guard
type: Spirit-tablet array · honoring the Pagoda-Bearing Heavenly King Li and his daughter
structure: Spirit tablets for Heavenly King Li and Nezha placed deep in the cave
principle: Worships the father-daughter tablets · seeks protection through their bond
weakness: Wukong found the tablets · lodged a complaint in Heaven · Heavenly King Li descended in person
result: The tablets became evidence against her · Heavenly King Li captured the girl
feature: A rare case of self-protection via 'divine status' · exploiting a father-daughter bond to resist the law
